claims: The 90th Masters Tournament takes place April 6–12, 2026, at Augusta National Golf Club.
Masters Tournament rounds run from April 9–12, 2026.
Rory McIlroy enters as the 2025 champion.
Scottie Scheffler is a top contender.
Bryson DeChambeau is a top contender.
Tiger Woods is absent from the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Practice Rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are Monday, April 6 – Wednesday, April 8.
Par 3 Contest for the 2026 Masters Tournament is Wednesday, April 8 from 2 p.m.–4 p.m. ET on ESPN.
Tournament Rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are Thursday, April 9 – Sunday, April 12.
ESPN and the ESPN App feature live coverage of featured groups and Amen Corner throughout the 2026 Masters week.
Collin Morikawa returns to action after a back injury.
Jason Day enters a new partnership with TIAA.
